description: This file defines a PHP trait named CsrfTokenManagerTrait within the namespace OrangeHRM\Authentication\Traits. The trait provides a method to access a CsrfTokenManager instance via dependency injection, using another trait ServiceContainerTrait and a service container. It's part of the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system, specifically related to authentication and CSRF token management.

methods.name: getCsrfTokenManager
methods.description: Returns an instance of CsrfTokenManager from the service container.
